# Māngabz fixtures

`series.html` contains metadata and 978 chapter links from [海賊王](https://www.mangabz.com/139bz/), captured on 2026-10-25. It preserves hidden and pinned entries, descending order, and distinct IDs with matching labels. The synopsis includes its hidden continuation and the source's `ONEE PIECE` spelling.

`reader.html` contains the reader declarations for chapter `29397` and its 20-page count. Signing values are synthetic. Browser mocks use the captured response format and first image paths, controlled paths for later batches, and generated PNG images.
